author: Animan
description:
In this Top 10 Anime Recommendations list, we cut through the filler to find the Best Anime with ZERO Bad Episodes. We all know the pain of starting a show like Jujutsu Kaisen or Demon Slayer only for the plot to drag, but these 10 hidden gems are perfect from start to finish. From the dark mafia revenge story of 91 Days to the psychological mystery of Odd Taxi, these are the shows that respect your time.

We breakdown why Link Click (Link Cheng) might actually be better than your favorite Shonen, why Land of the Lustrous proves CGI isn't always bad, and why A Place Further Than the Universe will make you cry. If you are tired of "mid" anime and want Seinen, Sci-Fi, or Thriller recommendations that are 10/10 masterpieces, this list is for you.
